experiment_type: supervised domain expert pretraining and merging; shared sees A+B

d2nn_AB.schedule: same sampled data curriculum as MoE

formal_inference: fixed checkpoint, automatic routing, no task ID
test_policy: evaluate only after selection sealed; no test selection
note: User explicitly requested an additional EuroSAT optical/SAR experiment following the previous procedure. Models, losses, optimizer and stage epochs unchanged. Equal paired domains use 125 single-domain steps for BOTH A and B; paired stages retain250 steps. MoE/AB17500 updates each; A-only/B-only8750 each. No CORe50 learned weights reused.

split_policy.method: five stratified geographic group folds, seed42; fold0 test, fold1 validation, folds2-4 train

input_encoding.A: official EuroSAT RGB JPEG64x64, fixed common center56x56 crop
input_encoding.B: VV/VH dB reprojected to the paired optical center56x56 grid, original-author 1/99 percentile clip and fixed mean+-2std scaling; RGB=(VV,VH,mean(VV,VH))
input_encoding.augmentation: same horizontal flip and ColorJitter(.1,.1,.1,.02) for all models and domains
